ops.find: Tirana Mayor Erion Veliaj, held in pre-trial detention on corruption charges he denies, accused Prime Minister Edi Rama of orchestrating his Oct 28 transfer to Fier prison and of using Justice Minister Toni Gogu to demand he give up control of the city, Tirana Times reports;
ops.with: Albania's jailed Tirana mayor, Erion Veliaj, accuses Prime Minister Edi Rama of orchestrating his Oct 28 prison transfer, which the government denies. Veliaj, held in pre-trial detention on corruption charges he denies, also said Justice Minister Toni Gogu demanded he give up control of the city, Tirana Times reports;
